title: TrailGenic Rucking Conditioning Dataset
description: Canonical aggregate plus selected-session TrailGenic conditioning module for flat fasted rucking under progressive external load. It does not expose raw telemetry.
correction_notice: Heart-rate drift values were corrected on 2026-08-18. Prior drift values and derived interpretations are superseded. Drift is descriptive and is not a measure of metabolic flexibility.

records.mechanism: The load-adjusted HR-per-mile proxy normalizes average heart rate for distance and carried load; it is a descriptive comparison aid rather than a validated economy score.

aggregate_finding.definition: average heart rate divided by distance and relative load factor
aggregate_finding.load_progression_signal: External load increased from 10 lb to 20 lb while the load-adjusted proxy remained descriptive of the observed sessions.
aggregate_finding.interpretation: Arithmetic load normalization is exploratory and does not measure mechanical work or isolate causal economy.

summary_statistics.recovery_observation: 17 ready; 0 not ready; 1 missing. Source labels, not verified recovery.

methodology.metric_formula: load-adjusted HR-per-mile proxy = average heart rate / (distance miles × (1 + load lb / bodyweight lb))
methodology.purpose: Describes average cardiovascular cost after a simple carried-load normalization.
methodology.caveat: The proxy is not validated and cannot isolate external load from temperature, pace, hydration, sleep, or accumulated training.
methodology.claim_boundary: Conditioning tracking only. HR drift and proxy values do not establish metabolic flexibility, biological age, causality, or clinical efficacy.

claims: 18 entries through September 15, with five repeated 20 lb exposures (S14–18).
The 20 lb block averaged 112.6 bpm, effort 1 and zero anaerobic effect; recovery flags do not independently establish load absorption.
17 ready flags and one missing flag (S12).

source_provenance.filename: Trailgenic World Model Datasets - MASTER Values Only - Sep1726.xlsx
source_provenance.charter: TG World Model Datasets Charter v1.0 — September 2026
source_provenance.author: Mike Ye
source_provenance.interpretation: Ella; final judgment remains with Mike Ye

evidence_labels.recorded: Field entries and wearable outputs; device estimates are not laboratory measurements.
evidence_labels.unmeasured: No autophagy measurement; no recovery outcome inferred from missing follow-up.

recovery_field_boundary: Ready/not-ready are source classifications with unspecified timing and method; they do not independently establish post-session recovery.

data_quality_notes.detail: Session 12 recovery flag is missing; do not count it as ready.

decision_rule.rule: Hold 20 lb; review repeated in-session tolerance, symptoms and timed recovery before increasing load.
